title: Ebola Deaths Pass 4,100 as Kenya Confirms First Imported Bundibugyo Case
detail: Reporting this week put the DRC Bundibugyo toll above 8,600 confirmed cases and 4,100 deaths (4,148 in the 8 October report). A WHO-based count from 6 October listed 8,728 confirmed cases, 4,205 deaths and 2,269 recoveries across 64 health zones in seven provinces. Ituri remains the worst-affected province while North Kivu accounts for a growing share of new infections. Figures differ by source and cutoff date. No licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, and WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions.

media.caption: Ebola spreads in eastern DRC as Kenya confirms imported case
